body: MLS audit item 1: the hybrid DM downgrade is closed by PINNING the peer RSA key (VibeSecureTrust.evaluateTransport, fail-closed in ChatEngine.sendMessage/editMessage), not by refusing to seal hybrid. Android publishes no MLS KeyPackages, so refusing would stop every iOS<->Android DM; pinning leaves the same first-contact-only residual risk the MLS path already accepts.
author: Vibe Team
